response.original_title: What are the factors I should look into while buying a 4 BHK flat in Ahmedabad?
response.overview: Buying a 4 BHK flat in Ahmedabad is a major decision, so it is important to check more than just the price and size of the property. Start by looking at the location, connectivity, carpet area, floor plan, construction quality, builder reputation, legal approvals and available amenities. The location should have good access to schools, hospitals, shopping areas, workplaces and major roads. You should also check whether the project has RERA registration and all the required approvals. Your budget is another important factor. Apart from the property price, consider registration charges, stamp duty, parking, maintenance deposits, interior costs and other applicable charges. Before taking a home loan, use a home loan interest rate EMI calculator to understand your monthly payment.
